budget_gate.B_bound: min(historical4453855.0958829, current allocation successful local-download probe rate, any subsequently lower observed return rate)
budget_gate.I_bound: max(historical20.244484609999972, newly observed preflight initialization seconds)
budget_gate.during_formal: 1.25*(e +1.5*(200-u)*t_bound +2*W/B_bound +120 +180) <=D; elapsed includes completed formal initialization and updates
budget_gate.early_bandwidth_gate: Before expensive setup:1.25*(max(P,e)+I_bound+300*t_reference+2*W/B_bound+120+180)<=D; tentative until actual preflight gate
budget_gate.elapsed: All billable allocation elapsed, including preparation and waiting. Carry forward live actual usage; if actual billedCU exceeds rate*elapsed estimate, increase accounted cost before gating.
budget_gate.failure: If a gate fails, no formal start or stop as resource-incomplete and release; no reducedU checkpoint/effect result, no retry/allocation merely to consume remainder.
budget_gate.release: Retain180s inside the whole25 margin; external actual CU/time watchdog remains a hard upper bound, terminate/release before either hard cap.
budget_gate.t_bound: max(historical1.6807091929999842, measured preflight timed-update p90, subsequently observed update p90); no loss/dev-driven budget choice

margin_definition: 1.25 applied to complete allocation estimate including preparation, preflight, formal load/training, complete checkpoint return, bookkeeping and180s release. Existing50% training and100% transfer buffers also retained. At later gates apply1.25 to elapsed+remaining estimate; do not drop margin on elapsed preparation.
